name: Cascadia qwen35 GPU keep-alive
summary: Cascadia 0.2.7 plus the qwen35 staged-pipeline GPU keep-alive: while a pipeline rank waits for the next activation, a tiny GPU inference every 2 ms keeps the Intel iGPU from idling, which removes ~0.5 s stalls on 40-50% of decode steps on 20+ GB stages. Also carries the GPTQ-to-OpenVINO builder fix (signed INT4 experts) the Qwen3.5-122B IR needs to compile on the iGPU.
notes: Branch feat/qwen35-keepalive-profiling (PR to labscommunity/cascadia); opt-in with --gpu-keepalive-ms 2 / CASCADIA_QWEN36_GPU_KEEPALIVE_MS=2. Outputs are unchanged (greedy decode, parity-checked against the stock build); only the per-token latency changes. Becomes a stock flag once the PR merges.
